name: explain_conversation
title: Why a conversation went wrong
description:
What happened in one conversation or flow run: who it is with, which flow ran, how it ended or what it is
waiting for in plain words (`what_happened`), the cards it went through (`trail`, oldest first), which fields
were collected and which are missing, and other runs on it. Give `conversation_id` (its latest run) or `run_id`.
`edited_since_this_run` means the current flow may not explain this run. With the conversation-content
permission it also has `collected_values`, `recent_messages`, the customer's name and each step's error text.
Emails and phone numbers are masked; other values are shown as collected.
